headline: Wirtz Kept In, test1 Kept Happy
deck: Liverpool won't sanction a Wirtz exit, so test1 keeps his asset.
body:
The gossip pages have Barcelona ruling out Alvarez and Chelsea circling an English midfield pair, but the line that matters here is Liverpool's refusal to let Wirtz go. He belongs to test1, and for now he stays exactly where test1 wants him.

Nothing in the copy touches his fitness or his minutes, so nothing here does either. A door that might have opened has been shut, and test1's squad sheet reads the same tonight as it did this morning.
